dispute.claim_text: Sengkang to Marina Bay through the KPE is 18-19 km. The app says 21.2 km and charged me $34.42 with $3 of ERP. I was on my phone so I did not watch the route, but the timing does not make sense to me - 39 minutes at 6.30pm on that road. I asked for the route map and support could not show me one.

counterparty_statement.text: I took the KPE like always. My phone loses signal in the tunnel, that is not my fault.

admissibility.notes: Trip record complete and causally ordered. Note that its actual_distance_km is itself derived from the impaired trace, so it adds no independent evidence of distance.

dropoff.label: Marina Bay Financial Centre Tower 3, 12 Marina Blvd

payload.optimal_route_source: routing-engine-v3.2 (LTA traffic snapshot 18:19; optimal is KPE then ECP, crossing both gantries)

issue_details.detail: One 428.0 s dropout inside the KPE tunnel, bounded by the Defu Flyover portal fix and the Kallang portal fix, 6.90 km apart in a straight line. The gap covers the entire segment the rider disputes.
coverage_pct 81.7: 428 s of dropout across a 2340 s active window, below the 90.0 threshold.

admissibility.notes: The dropout is over POL-RD-07's own 90 s limb, so the trace is impaired for policy and not merely for admissibility. Measured the pro-driver way, straight line across the gap, the trip is 21.20 km and below the POL-RD-01 threshold; a surface route between the same two portals would put it at 25.50 km and over. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two.

issue_details.detail: truncated flag set and last_message_at is 18:26:14, 2186 s before ended_at, far over the 120 s TRUNCATION_TOLERANCE_SEC.

admissibility.notes: Whatever was said after 18:26:14 is not in the export. There is no driver admission anywhere in the surviving log, so the chat cannot supply the corroboration POL-RD-07(b) asks for.

issue_details.detail: erp_gantries is null against a non-zero tolls_erp of 3.00, so the gantry itemisation the fare implies is absent and no on_optimal_route check is possible.

admissibility.notes: distance_charged_km of 21.20 is identical to the trace figure, so the ledger is not an independent measurement and corroborates nothing. The missing itemisation is a PARTIAL_RECORD, not a phantom charge: trip.optimal_route_erp_sgd is also 3.00.

issue_details.detail: No LTA advisory covers the KPE or the ECP in the 18:19-19:02 window on 22 July 2026.

admissibility.notes: Artifact absent. The identifier is minted anyway so that the absence itself can be cited by either advocate.
